source.publisher: National Crime Agency (NECC / JMLIT+ Financial Sanctions Circumvention Cell)
source.title: Red Alert: Exporting High Risk Goods

summary: UK NCA/OFSI/FCDO Red Alert (December 2023, ref. 0737-NECC) warning the financial sector about techniques used to evade sanctions on exports of high-risk goods to Russia for its war in Ukraine. It describes Russia deploying complex supply chains, alternative supply routes and third-country intermediaries (Turkey, UAE, Belarus, China, Serbia, Uzbekistan) to obtain Common High Priority List items such as integrated circuits and dual-use goods, names UK-sanctioned companies involved in procurement and supply, and sets out 14 red flags covering payment patterns, shell-like counterparties, trade-finance documentation and shipping routes indicative of sanctions circumvention.

extraction_notes: The overpayment red flag (p.4, item 4) did not cleanly match any Knowledge Centre typology (best search score 0.44, and that candidate, TBML002U Under Invoicing, is the opposite direction of value distortion); it is retained only as an indicator, not proposed as a typology link. SAN004 Front Companies is set to medium confidence: the document never uses the term "front company"; the link is inferred from red flags 1 and 6 (recent incorporation, no/low web presence) rather than an explicit statement. Named sanctioned entities (TURKIK UNION, AZU INTERNATIONAL, AEROMOTUS, FLY BRIDGE, NPP ISTOK, ECITECH) reflect UK designations as reported in this document (actions of 8 Aug 2023 and 8 Nov 2023); current designation status was not independently verified. The jurisdictions list mixes the target jurisdiction (RU), named diversion/transshipment jurisdictions (TR, AE, BY, CN, RS, UZ) and the reporting/exposed jurisdiction (GB) without further distinction, since the schema does not separate these roles. Document text was supplied as pre-extracted PDF text with some artefacts of line-wrap (e.g. mid-word spacing); citation quotes were chosen to avoid those artefacts and should be re-verified against the source PDF by the human reviewer.
